name: Free Music Finder
author: moshi
description: Search the Telegram music bot @MusicsHuntersbot through your own Telegram account and download tracks into your library. The bot is a third party and is not limited to freely licensed music; what you download through it is your responsibility.

settings.label: Open the search window
settings.description: Flip this switch (either way) to open the search window. You can also right-click any track → "Find more by this artist…".

settings.label: Download folder
settings.description: Leave empty to save into "Noctis Free Music" inside your first Noctis library folder, so downloads appear in the library right away (needs Watch Folders on). If you set a folder outside the library, add it to your Noctis library folders.

settings.label: Proxy
settings.description: Leave empty to connect to Telegram directly (or through a VPN that covers the whole computer). Where Telegram is blocked, put a Telegram proxy link here (https://t.me/proxy?server=…&port=…&secret=…) or a SOCKS5 proxy (socks5://host:port, or socks5://name:password@host:port). It is used from the next search or login on. Noctis keeps this setting as plain text.
